permissions.description: Expense claims, their lines and receipts, and their approval

actions.description: The caller's own claims, with their lines and receipts
Create, edit, submit and withdraw the caller's own claims, and attach or remove their receipts
Claims submitted by the caller's direct reports: read, approve and reject them
Every claim, with its lines and receipts

permissions.description: Expense categories and their maximum per line

actions.description: Create categories and set, change or remove their maximum
List every employee and assign or change an employee's manager
Export a selection of approved claims, marking them Exported
List past exports and download any of them again

roles.name: Employee
roles.description: Creates, submits, edits and withdraws their own claims and attaches receipts. Sees only their own claims; never decides a claim.

roles.name: Manager
roles.description: Reviews, approves or rejects claims of their direct reports, receipts included. Sees no other team's claims and never decides their own.

roles.name: FinanceOfficer
roles.description: Finance staff: exports approved claims to payroll, sets expense category maximums and assigns each employee's manager. Reads every claim but never approves or edits one.
